scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 Super Soul effect evidence
verification_policy: Separate community-tested mechanics from official item data. Numerical effects are recorded only when a specific secondary report provides them; they remain secondary until independently reconciled with item-level evidence.

sources.scope: Chapter 4 contains four new Super Souls
Player-reported testing of Chapter 4 Super Soul effects
Player testing/discussion of the meaning of all abilities for Chapter 4 Super Souls

records.name: This power... It's different from any I've ever had.
records.reported_effect: When below 50% max health, boosts all abilities by 20%.
records.notes: The community report describes testing this effect. It is not promoted to fully verified because no official item-level stat record was located in the available evidence.

records.name: I'll use this power to protect everyone!
records.reported_effect: At battle/quest start, deals 5000 damage to the user, allies, and enemies over approximately 30 seconds; afterward the wearer gains a reported 15% boost to all abilities.
records.notes: The numerical values are preserved as a secondary community report, not as an independently verified canonical stat record.

records.name: Malice... Existence... Cruelty...
records.reported_effect: Community discussion associates this Super Soul with HP regeneration, but the exact trigger, rate, duration, and any additional effects remain unresolved.
records.notes: No numerical HP regeneration value is recorded.

research_notes: Recent community testing provides concrete leads for at least three Chapter 4 Super Souls, but those reports are not treated as official item data.
The phrase 'all abilities' is discussed by players as affecting more than attack damage; one report explicitly mentions defensive and recovery-related properties. This remains secondary evidence.
The 5000-damage/30-second and 15% values for 'I'll use this power to protect everyone!' are recorded as reported values rather than canonical values.
No drop rate, Normal-versus-Ultimate-Finish mapping, or item ID is inferred from these effect reports.
